title: docs: plugin-detail.mdx still says `record:activity` `types: ['approval']` is legal; #34383 now refuses it
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding from the L2 contract-review record 6933431498 on PR #34524 (card #34383), passed on by area `o2-A`. It is the PR's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` card. Dedupe: `plugin-detail.mdx approval`, `record:activity types`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象:`content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` 第 373–374 行说，写 `types: ['approval']`「合法、能 typecheck、能 build」。#34383 落地后，这个写法在保存时会被拒。
- 为什么要修：文档和平台说的相反，照文档写元数据的人和 AI 会在保存时被拒，却以为是平台出了错。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

After PR #34524 merges, rewrite that passage to say what the platform now does: the shape is refused as `component-props-invalid` at `properties.types` / `properties.feed.types` on the CLI and page-save doors, and the console mirror (`@object-ui/types/zod`'s `safeValidateSchema`, `objectui validate`) refuses it from the same release (L2 N2). A stored page carrying the shape still loads; its next save is refused. Take the wording from the PR's semantic entry. Do not restate the rule elsewhere.

## Done when

`git grep -n "approval" content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` shows no line calling the shape legal, and the PR body lists the before and after lines.

Blocked-by: none (dispatch after PR #34524 merges; same area `o2-A`).
